title: No improvement claim below the per-case noise floor

body.signal: A reported gain whose magnitude is within run-to-run variance for that case.
body.failure_mode: Per-case floors (1.4826 x MAD of centered repeats) ranged 0.00-20.92 pp in phase0; pooled robust floor 4.80 pp; without floors, near-floor 'wins' are noise wearing a medal.
body.detection: Compute the floor per case from at least 20 repeated pipeline runs before comparing arms; report medians, never means (heavy tails: one anagram repeat at -30,578.9 percent).
body.fix_strategy: Block promotion of any run-level 'improvement' claim whose paired delta is not above the case floor; 12 paired cases detect a 5 pp median effect at alpha .05, power .8.

provenance.note: Seeded from hand-authored/analyzed artifacts; promoted by human decision, not agent replay.

counterfactual.evidence: N/A for seeds - promoted by human authorship at engine bootstrap.
